main_text.p: bus diligentibus me & custodientibus præcepta mea. Exod. 34. v. 67. Transiens, Jehova ante eum, clamavit: Jehova, Jehova, Deus misericors & clemens, tardus ad iram, & multum mi-sericordiâ & veritate, servans misericordiam millibus, auferens iniquitatem & transgressio-nem & peccatum, & innocentem non faciens, visitans iniquitatem Patrum super filios, & su-per filios filiorum in tertios & in quartos. (Visitare est hic, ob peccata inquirere, in iisdem deprehendere homines, ut Deus eos puniat) Numer. 14. v. 18. Jehova est longanimus, & multus benignitate, condonans iniquitatem & defectionem, qui prorsus non absolvit, (fontem) visitans iniquitatem patrum in filios, in nepotes & abnepotes.

Est igitur in Deo summa benignitas, Clementia, & Misericordia : & summa rectitudo, æquitas & justitia tum remunerans, tum vindicans. Psal. 145. v. 17. Justus Jehova in omnibus viis suis, & benignus in omnibus operibus suis.
2. Ergo secundum sententiam à se latam odit & exsecratur omnes peccatores, & legis suæ transgressores. Psal. 5. vers. 5. &c. Nam non es Deus fortis, qui delectetur improbitate, non est commoraturum

page.notes: The printed word "multum" at the start of the Exodus quotation is hard to read; the line-end hyphen "mi-" and "fericordiâ" were joined as misericordiâ. The reading "defectionem" and "multum" are uncertain. The last word "apud" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. The printed page number is read as 164. The scripture references are copied as printed, including "Exod. 34. v. 67.", which may be a printing error for 34:6–7.
